articles.summary: In mCRPC patients with androgen receptor (AR) mutations, treatment with MRT-2359 in combination with enzalutamide led to a 100% PSA response rate (5 of 5 patients) and a 100% disease control rate, including 2 patients with RECIST partial responses and 3 with stable disease, all showing reduction
articles.title: Monte Rosa Therapeutics Presents Updated Clinical Data from Phase 1/2 Study of MRT-2359 in Combination with Enzalutamide in Heavily Pretreated Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer Patients at ASCO Genitourinary Cancers Symposium (ASCO GU)
